question: Should OpenClaw core own this experimental Claw lifecycle diagnostics surface and its Doctor integration, or should the lifecycle stack remain outside core until a different extension boundary is approved?
rationale: The patch is a substantial new core capability built on open stacked ownership work; correctness evidence cannot determine the intended permanent product and ownership boundary.

options.title: Pause pending core-scope approval
options.body: Do not merge this diagnostics slice until a maintainer explicitly sponsors the experimental core Claw and Doctor ownership model.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded experiment
options.body: Accept the gated core direction, require exact-head proof and dependency-order landing, and keep the contract explicitly experimental.

options.title: Route to an extension boundary
options.body: Decline the new core Doctor surface and identify the plugin or ClawHub seam required for lifecycle diagnostics outside core.

recommendation.title: Pause pending core-scope approval
recommendation.body: Do not merge this diagnostics slice until a maintainer explicitly sponsors the experimental core Claw and Doctor ownership model.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comment defines the key diagnostic and read-only safety invariants that need confirmation if this direction is sponsored.
